title: precision joints, guides and assisted handling modules

specimens.name: Maintenance-free spherical rod-end bearing
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Precision steel rod-end joint with sealed spherical bearing insert, threaded shank and clean standardized finish; no attached linkage or machine.

specimens.name: Clevis joint with spherical-bearing cartridge
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Machined clevis and cross-pin around a replaceable spherical-bearing cartridge with retaining hardware; compact local joint only.

specimens.name: Recirculating linear-guide carriage on short rail
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One precision recirculating-ball linear-guide block riding on a short hardened guide rail with evenly spaced mounting holes; no actuator or machine.

specimens.name: Preloaded sealed guide-roller carriage
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Compact carriage with four small sealed precision rollers arranged around a short machined guide profile; no larger track, frame or machine.

specimens.name: Electric wire-rope winch with encoder/brake module
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Compact motor-reducer winch with drum, integrated brake housing, small encoder/feedback can and only a very short steel-cable tail; no boom, frame, vehicle or crane.

specimens.name: Electric chain-hoist module with limit-switch housings
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Compact hoist body with motor/gear housing, short load-chain tail, hook and two small physical end-limit switch housings; no beam, trolley, crane or structure.

specimens.name: Gas-spring counterbalance strut with ball-joint ends
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Industrial gas spring with polished rod, dark cylinder and standardized ball-joint/socket ends; no door, hatch or surrounding mechanism.

specimens.name: Compact rotary indexing bearing-and-lock module
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Low-profile precision rotary bearing housing with one indexing/locking plunger module and circular mounting pattern; local handling/indexing primitive only, not a complete rotary table.

rough welded clevises, exposed crude bushings, generic pillow-block bearings as the dominant vocabulary or hand-cranked winches
pipework, wiring harnesses, control panels, screens, lamps or complete hydraulic systems
baked cast shadows, contact shadows, glow, bloom, rays or temporary FX
photorealistic product catalog rendering, filtered 3D render or soft studio photography

era_contract.character: late-1990s precision handling vocabulary using spherical bearings, recirculating guides, sealed roller carriages, feedback-equipped lifting modules and compact indexed motion hardware
required_signals: precision linear guides and sealed rollers
gas-spring counterbalance and precision indexing modules
replaced_previous_language: E1 forged clevises with plain bushings
generic sealed pillow-block bearing as the primary precision cue
electric winch/hoist modules without feedback or limit hardware
forged turnbuckles and mechanical indexing plungers as the main service hardware
forbidden_regressions: generic E1 roller/pillow-block vocabulary without precision guides
unsealed crude bearings or improvised assemblies
